en: An old sepia-toned postcard depicting a town square bordered by ornate buildings. The main focus is a large equestrian statue of a man in military attire, placed on a pedestal in the square. Visible in the background are shops with German signage, including a barbershop named 'Max Heinemann, Friseur.' The upper text reads 'Oschatz' and 'König Albert-Denkmal auf dem Altmarkt.' There are some pedestrians, and the overall scene suggests an early 20th-century setting.
